title: [review] messaging.py:142: Duplicate message IDs silently
description: POST with an existing id replaces the stored message without error or warning. Line 143-144 correctly avoids duplicating in _sent_order, but line 142 overwrites content. This could cause silent data loss if a client accidentally reuses an ID. Consider returning 4.09 Conflict for duplicate IDs, or document this as intentional idempotent behavior.
